cheeger.description: Deployment-wide ceilings for each Cheeger calculation. Policies inherit these or choose smaller budgets; prioritized search never weakens hard bounds.

maxVertices.description: Maximum vertices per boundary; defaults to 20. Larger connected boundaries also need increased cut and time budgets.

maxCuts.description: Maximum distinct cuts per calculation; 524287 covers 20 vertices. Budget exhaustion blocks constrained actions.

timeoutSeconds.description: Cooperative runtime ceiling per calculation, checked between batches. Incomplete search is never an exact constant.

writeQueue.description: Bound concrete Kubernetes writes separately from coalesced reconciliation hints.

plannerParallelism.description: Maximum mutation callbacks per approved planner batch. One keeps batches serial; callers may lower this ceiling only. Parallel transport also needs maxInFlight slots and sufficient maxInFlight + maxPending admission capacity per adapter. Dependency and shared-budget checks still apply.

maxPending.description: Extra admitted writes beyond maxInFlight per adapter. One favors fresh decisions; zero removes extra capacity. Unproven independence can still cause admitted items to wait. Overflow requires fresh reconciliation.

validationIntervalSeconds.description: Maximum pause between validation passes; watch notifications wake the producer sooner. Must not exceed validationWindowSeconds.

validationWindowSeconds.description: Maximum reusable validation age measured from its start. Shorter windows add reads; longer windows tolerate more unobserved external drift. Events and relevant writes invalidate receipts immediately.

validationBurst.description: Maximum candidates validated per background pass; spare window time advances through later queued items without adding mutation concurrency.

maxInFlight.description: Concurrent writer slots per API adapter. One preserves serial transport; higher values admit only independent writes approved by the same refreshed mutation batch. Unknown effects remain ordered.

validationWorkers.description: Concurrent candidate validations per API adapter, shared by the background producer and dispatchers. Increasing this consumes Kubernetes read capacity.

reconciliationWorkers.description: Concurrent local reconciliation attempts and remote deliveries per cluster. Same-key follow-ups and graph-family leases remain serialized; separate families can prepare decisions together.

reconciliationCooldownSeconds.description: Shared cooldown window in seconds; zero disables additional pulse pacing. Refused work retries from fresh state.

reconciliationBurst.description: Maximum new pulses admitted in one cooldown window; duplicate retries do not extend the window.
